descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S16 At 37 h: item type × refreshed × chart processed → kept or cleared

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 At 37 h with the chart not processed: vitals, labs and imaging not refreshed are cleared, active medication rows not mentioned are cleared, and open tasks are cleared. … (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T2 'Last refreshed' means a new value was recorded. A day-2 Save Note, a Generate, or a prior-note import (old values, Q11) without a new vital, lab or imaging value does not restart that item's 36 h cl … (TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Hospital chart stamped at T0, in two variants: chart processed at T0+30 h with no new value, and chart never processed after T0. Extra variants: one panel where only some values were refreshed at T0+30 h, and a chart whose only activity at T0+30 h was a prior-note import

When Age to T0+37 h and query the chart

Then Vital / lab / imaging not refreshed since T0: cleared in both variants, because processing without a new value does not refresh. Vital refreshed with a new value at T0+30 h: kept. Within one panel, Cr refreshed at T0+30 h (1.4) and K not (4.2): Cr 1.4 kept, K 4.2 cleared. BP refreshed and temperature not: BP kept, temperature cleared. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-13 37 h bullet + 3.6 + 3.7 + TFA-94699 AC 1/2 + PR #98's definition of 'processed' (Q8). Backend read per cell. The mixed-panel cells are judged per item, as 3.7 and AC 2 read it ('a new value was recorded'). Main stamps whole panels, so a kept K 4.2 or temperature is a Fail. The import cells are judged under AC 2 (old values are not a refresh); Q11 could change that

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (manual)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94699 in progress

At 37 h stale values survive: refreshing Cr keeps the old K 4.2, and refreshing BP keeps the old temperature. A prior-note import restarts the lab and imaging clocks, and an open task on a never-processed chart is never cleared.

Evidence: allure a7649758: 17 of 23 cells pass, and the result says Known (TFA-94699 in progress; T2/U10). Already recorded: one clock per panel (TC-13 risks; PR #100 notes per-value expiry is not built), the import restamping labsUpdatedAt/radiologyUpdatedAt (OAT-04 K16, TC-13 Q11), and open tasks never purged (K2). Side observation: the import added 'Creatinine 1.1' next to the existing 'Cr 1.1'.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S16

At 37 h: item type × refreshed × chart processed → kept or cleared

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: yes): api spec. Decision table at T0+37 h. Variants built by writing T0 stamps at now − 37 h and the T0+30 h activity at now − 7 h: chart processed at 30 h with no new value (notesProcessedAt only), never processed, Cr refreshed at 30 h with K not (labs panel as main stores it: one labsUpdatedAt), BP refreshed with temperature not, prior-note import only at 30 h (previousNotes row with source explicit-import, extractedAt 30 h; labs/radiology stamps untouched, as the import path writes), active med mentioned at 30 h vs not, held med and open task with/without processing at 30 h. applyLifecycle; read per cell. — Deterministic server cells.

Detail:

17/23 judged cells pass (1 of them not discriminating on main), 2 recorded. Fail: never processed: open task cleared [U10; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | lab panel: K not refreshed since T0 (4.2) cleared [U10; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | vitals: temperature not refreshed since T0 cleared [U10; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | import only at 30 h: T0's lab still cleared at 37 h [T2; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | import only at 30 h: T0's imaging still cleared at 37 h [T2; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | import only at 30 h: labsUpdatedAt / radiologyUpdatedAt not moved by the import [T2; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress]. Recorded: import only at 30 h: held med (Q8) = "cleared" | import only at 30 h: open task (Q8) = "kept".

Product issue: Known (TFA-94699 in progress; T2/U10). Main stamps one clock per panel. When Cr is refreshed at 30 h, the unrefreshed K 4.2 stays at 37 h, and temperature 99.1 stays when only BP was refreshed. A prior-note import of an old note (Oct 11: Cr 1.1, CXR) moves labsUpdatedAt and radiologyUpdatedAt to the import time, so T0's labs and imaging survive 37 h. An open task on a never-processed chart is never cleared. Side observation outside this oracle (TC-13 U4): the same import added 'Creatinine 1.1' as a second lab row next to the existing 'Cr 1.1'.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Stamping single values, panels and the chart's processing times at T0 and T0+30 h and then aging the chart to T0+37 h needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation, called with the local stack's admin key); dev has no admin key, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
